channel.title: The Drill Down: all games
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 10: Vikings at Packers
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: GB -2.5 · O/U 42.5 | Model GB 72% vs. market 57% | The game turns on whether Minnesota's front can reach Jordan Love, since Minnesota's 25% pressure rate ranks first and Green Bay's offense ranks fourth in EPA per dropback. Matthew Golden absorbs 29% of Green Bay's targets, and he runs into a Minnesota pass defense ranked third. Our model has Green Bay at 72% against a market number of 57%, driven mostly by the passing matchup.

item.title: Week 10: Panthers at Saints
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: NO -1.5 · O/U 48.5 | Model NO 45% vs. market 50% | The fight in space decides this one: Carolina's defense ranks 1st in yards after catch over expected, while New Orleans' ranks 28th, so the Panthers must keep short throws from turning into chunk gains. Chris Olave soaks up 29% of New Orleans' targets and runs into a Carolina pass defense ranked 25th. Our model makes Carolina a 55% winner against a 50-50 market, driven chiefly by the rushing matchup.

item.title: Week 10: Patriots at Lions
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 9:30 AM ET | Line: DET -2.5 · O/U 50.5 | Model DET 54% vs. market 57% | The trenches decide this game: Detroit's pass rush generates pressure on 23% of dropbacks, and New England's line allows that same rate, so Maye's protection will shape everything. Our model puts Detroit at 54% against the market's 57%, with the rushing matchup providing most of the lift toward the Lions.

item.title: Week 10: Seahawks at Raiders
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 4:05 PM ET | Line: SEA -6.5 · O/U 40.5 | Model LV 48% vs. market 28% | On paper this one is close: Seattle's best edge is to keep everything in front (Seattle's defense ranks 1st in explosive play rate, 7.1% allowed), while Las Vegas's best counter is to finish drives (Las Vegas ranks 24th in red-zone TD rate, 58%). Under center, Sam Darnold ranks 25th of 31 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: Jaxon Smith-Njigba gets 35% of Seattle's targets and 48% of its air yards, and his WOPR (0.91) ranks 1st of 108. Las Vegas' pass defense ranks 32nd. The model favors Seattle at 52%, mostly on passing matchup (2.7 pts) and rushing matchup (1.4 pts).

item.title: Week 10: Steelers at Bengals
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 8:20 PM ET | Line: CIN -3.5 · O/U 49.5 | Model CIN 59% vs. market 66% | The game turns on whether Pittsburgh can establish the run early, since its designed runs rank 1st in EPA while Cincinnati's run defense ranks 26th. Jaylen Warren, the league's best at +2.1 rushing yards over expected per carry, has to carry that load while Aaron Rodgers faces Joe Burrow, who ranks 1st among quarterbacks. Our model gives Cincinnati a 59% win chance against a market price of 66%, a gap driven by the starting QB and passing matchup.

item.title: Week 10: Commanders at Giants
item.description: Thu 11/12 · 8:15 PM ET | Line: NYG -1.5 · O/U 40.5 | Model NYG 67% vs. market 53% | The game turns on Washington's tackling against a Giants offense that breaks the fewest tackles in the league, just 3.2% of touches. Malik Nabers draws 31% of the Giants' targets and runs into a Washington pass defense ranked 16th, making him the player to watch. Our model gives the Giants 67% to the market's 53%, with the rushing matchup and home field driving most of that gap.

item.title: Week 10: Rams at Cardinals
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 4:05 PM ET | Line: LA -9.5 · O/U 38.5 | Model ARI 18% vs. market 19% | Keep the pocket clean decides this one, since Los Angeles has the 2nd-best pass protection while Arizona's defense ranks 32nd in generating pressure. Our model and the market nearly agree, with the model at 82% for the Rams against the market's 81%, and the rushing matchup leads our number.

item.title: Week 10: 49ers at Cowboys
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 4:25 PM ET | Line: SF -4.5 · O/U 55.5 | Model DAL 41% vs. market 36% | Dallas has to win in the red zone, where its defense allows touchdowns on 63% of trips, ranking 23rd, against a 49ers offense that cashes in at a league-best rate. item.title: Week 10: Bills at Jets
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: BUF -8.5 · O/U 50.5 | Model NYJ 33% vs. market 20% | The game likely turns on whether Buffalo's passing game, which posts +0.17 EPA per dropback, can exploit a Jets defense ranked 31st against the pass. Our model has Buffalo at 67% against the market's 80%, with the passing matchup as the biggest driver of our number.

item.title: Week 10: Jaguars at Titans
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: JAX -10.5 · O/U 45.5 | Model TEN 21% vs. market 17% | Jacksonville throws deep left on 18% of its passes, and Tennessee allows +0.47 EPA per throw there, so the Titans must bracket that side before the Jaguars settle into a rhythm. Parker Washington draws 24% of Jacksonville's targets against a Tennessee pass defense ranked 30th, which makes him the most dangerous target on the field. Our model has Jacksonville at 79% against a market price of 83%, and the passing matchup drives most of that lean.

item.title: Week 10: Dolphins at Colts
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: IND -4.5 · O/U 37.5 | Model IND 58% vs. market 66% | Indianapolis has to lean on the run, because Miami's defense ranks 31st against designed runs and allows -0.07 EPA per carry. Our model has Indianapolis at 58%, well under the market, and the rushing matchup, worth 3.5 points, drives most of that gap.
